text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several weeks have passed since I began
watching over Mihono
Bourbon's secret
training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haaah... New personal... best!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your support. Upon full
recovery of stamina, I will
transition to the
interval training workout. Now moving to
the ramped
track.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Adjusting plan to include
modifications.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Stamina recharged. Commencing ramped
dash.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon races off without another
word. Despite the
strenuous training, she
never reveals any hint of weakness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing the strength and tenacity in her
run, a sense of pride wells
up inside of me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's only a matter of time before she's
ready for medium and long
distances...
Only one obstacle remains.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
So you're the one who's been giving her
endurance lessons behind my
back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, the changes in Mihono Bourbon's
condition catch her
trainer's eye. After
putting two and two together, he calls me
out.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This person is not involved with my
evening runs. I have been doing
everything
by my own will.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon, you really think I'm going to
believe that when you two
have been
meeting every night? I bet this trainer took
pity on you.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Listen, I've heard all about her lofty goals.
But you and me both, we
know the risks
involved. Do you really think I'm going to
let her run
those races?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If I may object, my entire purpose for
enrolling here is the Triple
Crown. I will
not accept anything less.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Exasperated by her stubbornness, the
trainer lets out a long sigh.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Fine. Then show me if you've got what it
takes. The Kikuka Sho is
3,000 meters.
Let's see you run that distance right now.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will prove my abilities to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We move to the course for Mihono Bourbon's 3,000-meter attempt. However, at her current level, I'm not sure she can finish, let alone finish fast.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(1,600 meters completed on time. 1,400
meters remain. Irregular air
intake
detected. Unable to maintain a steady
pace...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Agh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My gut was right. Around the 2,000 meter
mark, Mihono Bourbon's
speed starts
decreasing. It's all but a crawl by the time
she reaches
the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Just give up already. Stop doing this to
yourself. You're not built for
long
distances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After spending several weeks with Mihono
Bourbon, anyone can see
how determined
she is to participate in the Classic Triple
Crown
series.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Can't you see that all she's doing is hurting
herself? Why is it so hard
for you to
understand?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ugh never mind, there's no point in talking
to you. Bourbon, tell us
how you feel. I'm
sure you understood the reality of the
situation
when you were running.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: How I "feel"...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A hesitant Mihono Bourbon opens her
mouth to speak.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...The Triple Crown is non-negotiable. This
is one objective I must see
to the end.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please understand that I cannot give up
now.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...If that's what you want, then so be it. I
can't stand by your decision
in good faith.
Our training contract ends today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...

...I understand.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...I had high expectations of you, Bourbon.
You've disappointed me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shaking his head, the trainer turns on his
heels and leaves.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am currently experiencing "confusion"
due to the loss of my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is true that despite my supplementary
training, I was unable to run
3,000 meters.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I've based all my projections upon the
Triple Crown. Have I been
miscalculating
my whole racing career?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her perseverance to put herself through
such demanding training
without a single
complaint is no small feat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rather, it's a testament to Mihono
Bourbon's willpower and her desire
to
achieve the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon's eyes widen.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Together...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (These words... sound familiar...)

text_block_list.name: Young Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haaah... nngh... Father... I failed... again...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
You may not have a lot of stamina. But
what you've got is the heart to
keep going.
As long as you don't stop, everything's
gonna be all
right.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text: We'll get to the finish line together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (This trainer sounds just like my father.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to bear the awkward silence any
longer, I grab her attention.
She studies
my face for a moment before speaking.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your customized training plan allowed me
to achieve the first 1,600
meters today,
which is more than I could manage before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I feel that I will go far with you as my
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: From now on, I am in your care.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then, the so-called "cyborg" of Tracen
Academy grips my hand
firmly—but
warmly.
